recipes.name: Vanilla Berry Chia Seed Pudding
instructions: Mix together the chia pudding ingredients in a bowl or cup. Let it sit for 8 minutes.

Meanwhile, in a microwave-safe bowl, heat the frozen fruit at 600W for 1 to 2 minutes, or until fully thawed. Alternatively, thaw on the stove. Let it cool, then store away in an airtight container in the fridge until ready to use.
Returning to the chia mixture, stir again to redistribute the settled seeds. Then cover and refrigerate overnight to allow the chia seeds to gel.
When ready to serve, give it one more stir. Add desired toppings, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Nutrition tip: aim to use plant-based milk that is fortified with calcium .
Storage Store in an airtight container or mason jar in the fridge for up to 3 days.
